Completion evidence pointers:
- Workflow contract: `.github/workflows/_mutation.yml:32-115` derives the shard matrix, caps each job at 30 minutes, and always uploads per-shard artifacts; `gerrit-verify.yaml:32,43,133-142,328` pins the patchset, cancels superseded runs, and includes mutation in `vote.needs`; `test.yml:67-69` mirrors the reusable gate; `mutation.yml:4-20` provides weekly/manual all-shard sweeps.
- Documentation contract: `tests/scripts/test_mutation_gate.py:878` validates `docs/mutation-testing.md`, including phased policy, promotion evidence, manifest authority, and removal of legacy score tables.
- [operator-attested] At commit `9bb8a5460b`, `python scripts/mutation_gate.py smoke --shard compact-policy --base HEAD^ --head HEAD` used fresh archives and passed 7/7 mutants killed, with zero survivors, no-tests, timeouts, failures, or advisories. Evidence directory: `/tmp/rebar-mutation-smoke.2QzHGH`.
